verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services, not a software platform with production data or APIs, so a sandbox test environment is a category error for this kind of product. The Clerky partnership is a third-party formation platform, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm itself ships any testing environment; the probe found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
